clusters.name: Transfer Orders
clusters.reason: Multiple PRs relate to the creation, completion, reconciliation, and item feeds for transfer orders between HotWax and NetSuite. These all represent steps in the same business process.

clusters.name: Shipment Synchronization
clusters.reason: PRs focus on synchronizing shipment data between NetSuite and HotWax, including skipping completed items and excluding specific feeds.

clusters.name: Reconciliation Feed
clusters.reason: PRs address issues and enhancements related to the reconciliation feed, specifically order date support and empty file generation.

clusters.name: Inventory Synchronization
clusters.reason: PRs relate to the synchronization of inventory data, including resets and variance exports.

clusters.name: Order Processing
clusters.reason: PRs address issues with POS order history creation and mix-cart order detection.

clusters.name: Data Model
clusters.reason: PR moves view-entity to a different repository.
